name: playful-mirror-selfie-curly-hair
image_purpose: Social outfit portrait and playful selfie

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical mirror selfie of an approved adult with curly dirty-blonde hair, preserving the beige waffle-knit top, patchwork cuffs, red choker, iridescent phone, and grid divider.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long voluminous curly dirty-blonde hair, hazel-green eyes, winged eyeliner, and playful tongue-out expression. Wear a beige waffle-knit long-sleeve cropped top with distressed denim patchwork cuffs and white decorative stitching, plus a red string choker with a small gold charm.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror selfie with right hand holding a holographic phone case and round pop socket, left hand twirling a curl, long holographic silver manicure, black-and-white grid room divider behind her. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse indoor light, realistic hair strand and knit texture, relaxed social-media portrait atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, vertical 9:16, natural reflection, crisp fabric, hair, manicure, and phone-case detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with long voluminous curly dirty-blonde hair, hazel-green eyes, winged eyeliner, and a playful tongue-out expression. She wears a beige waffle-knit long-sleeve cropped top with distressed denim patchwork cuffs and white decorative stitching, plus a red string choker with a small gold charm.
